title: FujiMod OTA system manifest
description: A.JSN and B.JSN are the two interchangeable system manifests under FUJIMOD/SYSTEM/<firmware>/. The loader and file layer use the higher gen that parses; an unparseable manifest leaves the other slot active.

gen.description: Generation number. A commit writes the next generation into the older slot.

version.description: Release version copied from the selected release manifest. An absent version means an unknown release.

fs.description: File layer paths mapped to the full SHA-256 of the store file that supplies them.

additionalProperties.description: Full SHA-256 of the store file, in hexadecimal.
